title: Apply .claude/settings.json from scripts/claude-settings.json
description: One-time: cp scripts/claude-settings.json .claude/settings.json (Claude could not write its own settings file in auto mode). Then restart the session.

title: Decide the application stack and scaffold via /opsx:propose
description: Repo has tooling only. Run /opsx:explore then /opsx:propose to pick the stack (Netlify/Supabase/Shopify MCPs are available), then update .serena/project.yml language_servers, lefthook npm scripts, semgrep rulesets.
